purpose: Diagnostic capture locating lost transport feedback before versus after SRTCP destination routing
overrides: Bounded SRTCP TWCC trace before per-SSRC routing, pion/srtp/v3 v3.0.13
limitations: Private instrumented binary; synchronous diagnostics invalidate latency and resource comparisons. This isolates routing, not final end-to-end qualification.
interpretation: All 87 decrypted reports missing from the controller target the RTX SSRC. Decrypted feedback counters are contiguous; the primary-only RTPSender reader omits these reports. Independent earlier source-path traces also show late receipts after loss-observation closure, which remains a separate issue.
